title: Velobuild CX-002 - Finally An Easy and Budget Cyclocross Frame

takeaways.text: The frameset retailed for US$599 plus custom paint and shipping, and is targeted at up to 42 mm tires.
His matte-black size-54 frame weighed 1,261 g, the uncut fork 438–439 g and the seatpost 237–238 g.
He calls the front-derailleur cable stop the worst design on the market for mechanical shifting, so it takes extra setup time; 1× or electronic shifting avoids it.

disclosure: VeloBuild sent the frameset. The January 2023 frame was later built with through-headset routing, consistent with the 2023 internal-routing version.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in of a size-54 VeloBuild CX-002 cyclocross frameset.
